ios.desc:
Menopause Stage - Clearblue® me app is designed for use with Clearblue® Menopause Stage Indicator tests to help you learn more about your menopause journey[1]. Together with the easy-to-use follicle stimulating hormone (FSH) tests over several days, the app will indicate your likely menopause stage as premenopause, early perimenopause, late perimenopause or postmenopause. The more you learn about your stage, the better prepared you can be.
 
But even if you’re not ready to start testing, the app is packed with loads of great features and content to help you learn more about the menopause journey, plus you can track your cycles and symptoms over time.

Creating an account is easy. Just add a few details and you’re all set to go! The app allows you to store and securely back-up all of your data so it’s safe, even if you lose your phone. 
 
KEY FEATURES when used with the Clearblue® Menopause Stage Indicator tests:

+ Track FSH over several days 
• with 5 simple-to-use urine FSH test sticks 
• accounts for natural variability in FSH day-to-day

+ Easy testing routine
• in-app step-by-step guide
• get smart reminders and an in-app countdown timer option

+ Unlock your likely menopause stage
• after logging 5 FSH tests, the app combines your test results with your age and cycle data to unlock your likely menopause stage

+ Personalized report 
• get a personalized report you can share with your healthcare professional
• includes your likely menopause stage, how your stage was determined, FSH results, and any symptoms you’ve tracked
• choose a 10-day symptom snapshot or a more detailed 6-week symptom view


For more information visit www.clearblue.com

Plus even more FREE features (optional):

+ Log your daily symptoms
• input up to 19 symptoms per day
• identify patterns in frequency and intensity over time

+ Track your periods
• see changes in your cycles

+ Join the community in weekly polls 
• Share your experiences & help others through their menopause journey 

+ Access relevant educational content 
• reviewed by scientists, experts and healthcare professionals 
• helps you learn about your journey

+ Support from trained product advisors 
• English & Spanish supported

Clearblue® me app is subscription free with no in-app purchases necessary. Clearblue® Menopause Stage Indicator test sticks sold separately. 

[1] Only a healthcare professional can confirm your menopause stage.

Interested in working with the tech team at SPD, the company who make Clearblue health products?

Our team is growing at a fast rate, with positions available for a senior devops and a mid level software engineer.

Our devops team are levelling up our micro-service and deployment infastructure. And the dev team are working with .NET MAUI to support our iOS[0] and Android[1] mobile apps. Our Menopause Stage indicator app has just launched in the US!
